business_summary: Town Health International Medical Group Limited, an investment holding company, provides healthcare and related services in the People's Republic of China and Hong Kong. It operates through four segments: Hong Kong Medical Services; Hong Kong Managed Medical Network Business; Mainland Hospital Management and Medical Services; and Others. The company provides medical healthcare, managed medical network, dental consultation, eyecare, private specialty healthcare, third party medical network administrator, and laboratory testing services. It also offers specialty services that covers cardiology, clinical oncology, dermatology, gastroenterology and hepatology, weight management and diabetes, neurosurgery, obstetrics and gynaecology, ophthalmology, orthopaedics, otorhinolaryngology, paediatrics, plastic surgery, psychiatry, urology, and nephrology; and dental services, such as general dentistry, prosthodentics, periodontology, oral and maxillofacial surgery, endodontics, orthodontics and paediatric dentistry etc. In addition, the company provides health check, and diagnostics and imaging services, such as PET- CT, MRI, CT, ultrasound scanning, endoscopy, cardiological examination, breast imaging, DEXA bone densitometry, X-Ray, lung function test, fundus photography, audiological test and full range laboratory service, etc.; physiotherapy services; traditional chinese medicine services; and medical beauty, body management, and life beauty services. Further, it offers property investment and management, hospital and health management, and business and corporate advisory services, as well as leases properties; and engages in the trading of medical consumables and equipment, and medicines. The company was formerly known as Town Health International Investments Limited and changed its name to Town Health International Medical Group Limited in March 2014. Town Health International Medical Group Limited was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Sha Tin, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Town Health International Medical Group Limited는 중화인민공화국과 홍콩에서 의료 및 관련 서비스를 제공합니다. 이는 홍콩 의료 서비스(Hong Kong Medical Services); 홍콩 관리 의료 네트워크 사업; 본토 병원 관리 및 의료 서비스; 및 기타. 이 회사는 의료 의료, 관리 의료 네트워크, 치과 상담, 안과 진료, 민간 전문 의료, 제3자 의료 네트워크 관리자 및 실험실 테스트 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 심장학, 임상 종양학, 피부과, 위장병학 및 간장학, 체중 관리 및 당뇨병, 신경외과, 산부인과, 안과, 정형외과, 이비인후과, 소아과, 성형외과, 정신과, 비뇨기과, 신장학을 포괄하는 전문 서비스를 제공합니다. 일반치과, 보철과, 치주과, 구강악안면외과, 근관치료, 치과교정과, 소아치과 등 치과 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 회사는 건강검진, PET-CT, MRI, CT, 초음파 검사, 내시경, 심장 검사, 유방촬영 등의 진단 및 영상 서비스를 제공합니다.
